paragraphs: Rav Pappa the Elder. He had eleven sons: Daru, Surhav, Rakhish, Rafram, Abba, Aha, Rami, Hanina, Abba Mari, Nahman, and Adda. Shalshelet Ha-Kabbalah, 34, end of a, writes in the name of Yuhasin that they all died in his lifetime. I do not know where he found this in Yuhasin. Yuhasin, under dalet, writes that Daru was in Rav's time (see there: he spoke in Rav's name; Rakhish likewise—see there—spoke in Rav's name). Some of them were sons of the Rav Pappa who was in Abaye and Rava's time (Rafram was in Rava's time; see there). He writes that he received from his father, who received from sages and elders, that they are effective against forgetfulness: one should say them seven times, and the charm is like mentioning Elijah. End quotation. See Yam Shel Shelomo, Bava Kamma, introduction, for the reason for reciting them. Rav Pappa the Elder said in Rav's name: Kiddushin 71b; Sanhedrin 49b; Menahot 33b. See above, R' Avin the Elder. גא״י [provisionally Gelilot Eretz Yisrael] writes: ‘The sons of Abaye and the sons of Rav Pappa are buried in the town of Mavnit.’ I do not know which Rav Pappa.
